bug.title: Science runtime cannot be safely reattached from port ownership alone
bug.summary: Science startup has refused a listener whose runtime identity could not be confirmed. Safe reattachment requires executable fingerprint, data-dir, unique listener PID, and managed launch identity to match the same runtime.

basis: user-reported managed Science port identity refusal

steps: Create an isolated managed-runtime record bound to a fixed executable fingerprint, data-dir, listener PID, and launch identity.
Exercise exact reattach, unknown listener, executable replacement, duplicate listener, and PID-race fixtures.
Allow adoption only when all four identity dimensions still agree.
Assert all mismatch cases fail closed without sending a signal to the foreign or changed process.
reproduction.observed: The user observed a refusal stating that the Science port was in use but the current process had no confirmable runtime identity.

confirmed_facts.statement: A Science listener with unconfirmed runtime identity has been reported and current policy forbids port-only adoption.

hypotheses.statement: The managed launch journal may not retain or revalidate enough identity to adopt the same runtime after Desktop restart.
